name: Albany
seo_title: Albany OR Christmas Events for Kids 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Albany, Oregon for 2026: Santa arriving by train, carousel breakfasts, a parade, Storybook Land and a Nutcracker.
lede: Albany starts the season when Santa rolls in by train at the Historic Carousel, then adds carousel breakfasts and storytimes, a downtown parade and tree lighting, Christmas Storybook Land and a Nutcracker.
celebrates: Albany's season centers on downtown and the Historic Carousel & Museum of Albany, which opens its Santa visits on November 28 when Santa arrives by train at 10:45 am. The Albany Downtown Association holds its Community Christmas Tree Lighting that same day and the Twice Around Holiday Parade on December 5. Christmas Storybook Land at the Linn County Expo Center is free, and the Albany Visitors Association lists a Nutcracker by Legacy Ballet and the Nighttime Magic home light contest. The Monteith House adds a children's pioneer Christmas party.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Albany, so this page uses the hosts' own 2026 pages. Those pages call several events annual: the carousel's Carousel Connection, Burl Wheaton's Holiday Storytime on the first Friday of December, and Nighttime Magic, now in its 39th year. Christmas Storybook Land says it has been free to the public since 1976, and Legacy Ballet says its Nutcracker began in December 2012.
facts: The Historic Carousel & Museum of Albany says it draws more than 117,000 visitors a year and that volunteers have served over 150,000 hours. Its home page counts 1,026 brass rings won. The museum sits at 503 1st Ave W, and its carving studio is where carvers such as Burl Wheaton work. The Albany Downtown Association says the 2026 Twice Around parade route is new, with a map on its event page.
trains: Albany's train moment is Santa Arrives by Train at the Historic Carousel & Museum of Albany on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 10:45 am, a free event where each child gets a free ride card. For a longer ride, the Candy Cane Express by Santiam Excursion Trains runs from Lebanon, a short drive east, and is listed on our Lebanon page once it is live.

traditions: Santa arrives by train at the Historic Carousel on November 28 at 10:45 am, with a free ride card for each child.
The Albany Downtown Association's downtown parade on December 5 at 6 pm, with horse-drawn wagons and the Albany Trolley.
Santa at 4 pm, the tree lighting at 6 pm and a sock drive for C.O.A.T. on November 28.
More than 200 handcrafted scenes at the Linn County Expo Center, free since 1976.
The Albany Visitors Association's 39th annual home light contest, running to January 1, 2027.
kidfact: Albany's carousel has given out a free ride card to each child at its Santa train arrival, and its riders have won 1,026 brass rings.
faq: Downtown Albany holds the Community Christmas Tree Lighting on November 28 and the Twice Around Holiday Parade on December 5. The Historic Carousel & Museum of Albany adds Santa visits, two breakfasts, a pajama party and storytimes, and Christmas Storybook Land is free at the Linn County Expo Center.
Does Santa arrive by train in Albany?

Yes. Santa arrives by train at the Historic Carousel & Museum of Albany on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 10:45 am by the carousel's own page. The Albany Visitors Association calendar lists 10:30 am, so arrive a few minutes early.
Yes. The host says admission and parking are always free, though the building is not heated, so dress warmly.
When is the Albany holiday parade?
The Downtown Twice Around Holiday Parade begins at 6 pm on Saturday, December 5, 2026, rain or shine, on a new route.
Are there nearby events outside Albany?
Yes. This page also lists the Harrisburg Nutcracker Light Parade on December 5 and the Millersburg Holiday Light Parade on December 4.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Albany for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events across Albany and 2 nearby towns, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Nighttime Magic Holiday Light Contest in Albany) through January 1, with Community Christmas Tree Lighting in Downtown Albany (November 28), Santa Arrives by Train at the Historic Carousel (November 28) and Santa Visits at the Historic Carousel (November 28 to December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in Salem. For the rest of the state, see our Oregon Christmas events for kids guide.
